content: BuiltWith returns full technology profile organized by category (CMS, hosting, analytics, frameworks, advertising, email, payment, CDN, e-commerce). Detects via HTML, JS files, HTTP headers, DNS records, cookies, tracking pixels, script URLs, third-party requests. Claims 112,000+ technologies tracked across 673M+ websites with historical data back to 1985 (weekly change tracking). Positioned as competitive/lead-gen intelligence tool, not primarily an SEO audit feature.
